## BuyFlow Gmail SHADOW Intake
Template-derived Gmail intake, adapted for BuyFlow.

**No Gmail writes. No labels. No drafts. No Sheets. No BuyFlow writes.**

Flow: Gmail Trigger → robust email extraction → BuyFlow request → safe empty candidate placeholder → existing Agent+Critic webhook → SHADOW audit result.

Before activation: open **📥 Gmail Trigger** and connect the Gmail OAuth credential. Candidate lookup intentionally stays disconnected until Identity Graph is wired.
